statements.quoted:
The proposed $1 trillion defense budget demands scrutiny, not celebration. While military readiness is non-negotiable, the Pentagon’s track record of waste undermines confidence. The 2025 Billion Dollar Boondoggle Act exposes systemic failures—projects like the F-35 program (5 years behind schedule, $165B over budget) prove bureaucracy burns cash faster than threats emerge. 

Real strength requires auditing every dollar, crushing contractor graft, and redirecting funds from redundant Cold War-era systems to asymmetric warfare capabilities. The administration’s focus on lethality means nothing if 20% of every dollar vanishes into consulting fees and legacy pork. 

Rebuilding requires ruthless efficiency, not blank checks.

statements.text:
.@DrOzCMS and the Trump administration are planning a pilot program to require prior authorization for traditional Medicare, including using AI to determine who needs care. 

It is not an exaggeration to say that this will kill seniors. @janschakowsky and I introduced a resolution condemning this disastrous idea and calling for CMS to immediately reverse course.

https://t.co/ldJVtuITJn

It is not an exaggeration to say that the requirement of prior authorization for traditional Medicare services will kill seniors. Not only that, but the use of AI in determining whether or not treatment is necessary is extremely reckless. Unlike Medicare Advantage plans that already use AI in prior authorization decisions, traditional Medicare is supposed to cover you, no questions asked.
statements.venue: Press release on resolution condemning Medicare WISeR prior authorization model
